7B  Grammar and speaking
Description
Students play a guessing game to review going to
Lesson link
Use this activity after exercise 2e, page 66
Time
10 minutes
Extra material None
Instructions
a Divide SS into pairs / teams of three. Ask them to
write eight statements – four true and four false
about what they’re going to do anytime in the
future (soon or distant).
b Ask teams to decide on a team name and write
them up on the board to keep score.
c Each team takes turns to read a statement. Other
teams have one minute to discuss each statement
amongst themselves and then guess whether it is
true or false (higher level classes could have three
minutes to question the team to decide if the
statement is true). Teams get one point for each
correct guess. The winning team is the one with
the most correct guesses.
